Equation 18:
\begin{aligned}\mu=&\left(\mu_{m}+\mu_{m}^{A}\frac{A}{A+\delta_{A}}+\mu_{m}^{P}\frac{P}{P+\delta_{P}}\right)\\&\left(\frac{G}{G+K_{G}}\frac{K_{IG}}{G+K_{IG}}+\frac{F}{F+K_{F}}\frac{K_{IF}}{F+K_{IF}}\right)\left(\frac{N}{N+K_{N}}\frac{K_{IN}}{N+K_{IN}}\right)\end{aligned}

Symbols (as printed -> plain name to use):
  \mu  ->  mu   (Specific growth rate (biomass formation) of active dry mass.)
  A  ->  A   (Ammonium concentration)
  F  ->  F   (Fructose concentration)
  G  ->  G   (Glucose concentration)
  N  ->  N_   (Nitrate concentration)
  P  ->  P   (Phosphate concentration)
  K_{F}  ->  KF   (Fructose saturation constant)
  K_{G}  ->  KG   (Glucose saturation constant)
  K_{IF}  ->  KIF   (Fructose inhibition constant)
  K_{IG}  ->  KIG   (Glucose inhibition constant)
  K_{IN}  ->  KIN   (Nitrate inhibition constant)
  K_{N}  ->  KN   (Nitrate saturation constant)
  \delta_{A}  ->  deltaA   (Minimum ammonium concentration in the medium at which cell growth occurs)
  \delta_{P}  ->  deltaP   (Minimum phosphate concentration in the medium at which cell growth occurs)
  \mu_{m}  ->  mum   (Maximum specific growth rate)
  \mu_{m}^{A}  ->  mumA   (Maximum specific growth rate for ammonium)
  \mu_{m}^{P}  ->  mumP   (Maximum specific growth rate for phosphate)
